resume: Eight-track drum machine with a step sequencer of up to 64 steps, Grids, compressor, two LFOs per track, resonators and live effects. The white keys are the steps.

commandes.role: Previous bank of steps on SEQ; with SEL active, octave from -2 to +2.
Next bank of steps on SEQ; held with a step, its accent; with SEL active, octave from -2 to +2.
FX, SLICER, RESON, delay, reverb, chorus. Held: PERFORM (performance effects on the black keys, mutes on the white keys).
KEYS mode: the keys play the selected track (the button is labeled SCL on the device).
Toggles STEPS / TRACKS: in STEPS, the white keys are the track's steps, whatever the page.
The track's two LFOs (LFO 1 on KNOB 1-2, LFO 2 on KNOB 3-4), then DEST.
The sound of the selected track: model and its settings.
Short press: global settings. Held: the MUTE screen.
Toggles between TRACKS (levels, lengths, pans) and HOME; held: the menu.
Short press: projects (save, load, name). Held: the cue map.
The steps on the white keys (short press: turns on or off), then PATTERN, MOTION and SONG.
Starts and stops playback; armed recording only starts with PLAY.
On TRACKS: arms the selected track. Elsewhere: REC ALL, all tracks armed to play drums live.
Turns the pages of a section; on TRACKS, sets the tempo.
Loads the next or previous preset on the selected track; EDIT held opens the list.
The track's steps (16 at a time per bank); on HOME or TRACKS, they play the eight tracks.

gestes: FX held: PERFORM, with live filters and effects.
GLO held: MUTE screen, one white key per track.
a_savoir: Four project slots, A to D; the last one saved loads at power-up.
